notes.title: Animation improvements and New Translations update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40206348/4adcabee5d2bf2d2ba76f23ff144dd38d64074e3.jpg

Hey guys!

As you guys already know, our Helping the Hotties has 🇺🇸 English voice overs, but it is also translated to  🇨🇳 Chinese and 🇹🇷 Turkish thanks to you, our community. 

Since you guys are playing it all around the world and you want to help translate it to other languages, we created a new way to make it happen. With your help we will translate two couples of languages at the time, starting with 🇫🇷 French, 🇮🇹 Italian, 🇵🇱 Polish and 🇷🇺 Russian. 

At the moment they are in different stages of translation, but as soon as one is finished, we will replace it with a new, most requested, language. Since we want for these translations to be the most accurate, we are looking for native speakers, or someone who is fluent in those languages to apply for the roles of translator and proofreader

You can find more info about it on our Discord server:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40206348/2c6f00a863b887cfa30f0d26eb84cbb85d6d0cf3.png


Some of you reported issues with the game once the animations were displayed. Issues like animations lagging and your devices getting loud and hot (just like some of our hotties), so we found what caused the issue and with this update, that issue should be finaly solved. Please hit us up if you'll still be experiencing this or any other issues with the game.

Also, we heard about some of you not enjoying our current ending, so what we decided to do is ask you, our fans, for help. We will have a dedicated channel on our Discord where we will discuss how to improve it so it makes sense, and if we find a solution that will make the game better, we will do it.

Thank you again for your feedback and for your support!

Cheers!

notes.title: Helping the Hotties - Progress Update
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Because there have been quite a few questions regarding the new Helping the Hotties update, we have decided to create this post with all the important information. During these past few months, we have been developing the new update and it is almost ready!

And if you have been wondering about what we have been working on… 

Before anything else, we have been focused on continuing the main story of the adult visual novel and further developing the stories of individual characters. As always, there are different paths of the story determined by your decisions and different opportunities to connect with the characters and discover new things about them. 

There is a lot that you are about to learn.

And let’s not forget about features like animations, voiceovers, collectibles and achievements. Although the voiceover feature has been put on hold for the time being, we have been working hard on adding the other features. Along with that, we have been fixing bugs and adjusting things as needed. 

Don’t want to leave a stone unturned!

But in addition to all that, we have been listening to your feedback and have decided to create a new design for the walkthrough to make it more convenient to use and help you better understand the consequences of your decisions, particularly when it comes to deciding which character to develop a relationship with and which path to choose. 

And here is the current plan…

After we are done with all the testing for the new update, the finished update will be released here on Steam, completely free of charge. Although the release date is yet to be determined, you can expect the update to be here by the end of June. 

Are you interested in other update reports, posts talking about what’s new and joining different discussions? Then check out our Discord and Twitter. 

Here is our Discord: https://discord.gg/PwmY9mwBFs 
This is our Twitter: https://twitter.com/xRedGamess 

Also, please do not hesitate to leave us feedback down in the comments!

What are your favorite features of this adult visual novel? 
Do you have a favorite character and scene from one of the previous updates?

notes.title: Episode 6 update is LIVE!
notes.content:
-- please run "Verify integrity of game files..." before first start of the game after this update

Hey guys,

Red Falls episode 6 is finally out! 

We have worked hard during these last couple of months to bring you, once again, the biggest update we've ever produced! We listened to your feedback and this is the first step (out of many) where we introduce the changes to Red Falls.


The Story
The story picks up when, at your most vulnerable, someone was watching. You think it was Emily, but it was too dark to tell. Jumping out of bed, driven by your detective instincts, you know what you must do. It's time to unmask the mysterious Forest Sucker, and resolve this nonsense once and for all!
As shown in one of the previous posts, the branching in episode 6 is bigger and more robust than in any of our previous releases.

The Sound
In terms of technical improvements, we have added sound effects throughout the whole game, and we will be adding music and some other sounds later on.

The Visual
Visual effects have been added and improved (sunscreen, water effects, etc.), as well as removing clipping and other visual defects found in previous episodes.

The Gameplay
Some structural changes have been implemented in the entire game (friendship and romantic relations, change of character's name), so from now on, you'll only be asked for your name and not for relationship status between the characters. 
The demo sequence from the pre-main menu screen has been moved to the start new game screen to make it more intuitive.
Unfortunately it is possible that some of your old saves won't work as expected. The game is still in development and we are, and will be, making big changes before the whole season is done.

The whole team is excited to bring you this episode and we all thank you for your support!

Feel free to join our Discord server where we can discuss Red Falls, Lewd Island and more...

Cheers and enjoy!

Red Falls Episode 5 update! 

Hey guys,

Welcome back to Red Falls! We've got a brand new episode just for you!

You continue the story as you leave Kiara's room. Disoriented and confused, you get into a fight with Emily, which results in "divine" Paul's intervention. Just as you started to recover from last night’s nonsense, one of the girls decides to pull a prank on you during the group activities. How rude of her! Life is rough, so you gotta be tough, Right? Really tough, especially when you realize that Jane is starting to suspect some things…

The new episode features more than 1422 new renders, 81 new animations inside the story, and more than 300 renders in the gallery, Blinks, Angles and X-Ray images!

Additionally, in this episode, you take part in the first fully controlled sex scene in Red Falls with one of the female characters, something I'm sure you guys will love.
